## How the costs are worked out. Run day and today, side by side.

Run day

The cost the write-up printed: the hourly price the machine was launched at that day, against what it measured. Prices move daily, so each run-day figure carries its date. Every run was a single run.

Today

The run-day figure moved by today's price: the "from" price per GPU-hour shown on /pricing, over the run-day rate per GPU-hour. A GPU that is not in stock right now reads "Not in stock" rather than a stale price. Prices read 2026-11-14 18:31 UTC.
